disclaimer: CDFW publishes plants as week-of ranges and warns that all fish plants are subject to change depending on road, water, weather and operational conditions. CDFW describes its schedule as covering 'planned releases in the immediate future, typically within two weeks'; some weeks carry none. This file holds RECORDED plants only — every week in it has already ended. Plants CDFW has announced for the current or a coming week are in stocking_current.json, where each row carries its tense.
